component.title: FormActions
component.purpose: Gives form actions consistent priority, responsive layout, and pending-state semantics.

states.description: Primary, reset, and cancel actions with clear hierarchy.
Submission in progress with disabled actions and live busy state.

claims.statement: The primary submit action is distinct from secondary and destructive-adjacent actions.
Pending submission disables actions and exposes a busy submit state.
Actions become full-width and touch-friendly on narrow viewports.
